task_completion.description: The agent successfully opens the OpenRocket application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenRocket GUI window is visible on the desktop.

task_completion.description: The agent opens the specific file located at /home/ga/Documents/rockets/stability_check.ork.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenRocket title bar or file menu shows 'stability_check.ork' is loaded.

task_completion.description: The agent views the stability margin, which should initially be low or negative due to the modified fins.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Stability' metric in the OpenRocket status bar or component analysis window shows a value (likely red or near 0 cal).

task_completion.description: The agent adjusts the fin height to restore stability.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Fin set' configuration dialog is open and the 'Height' slider or text field is being increased from the initial 1.5cm.

task_completion.description: The agent confirms the stability margin has increased to a safe level (typically > 1.0 cal).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The stability margin indicator in the GUI shows a higher numerical value and/or the Center of Pressure (CP) is significantly behind the Center of Gravity (CG).

task_completion.description: The agent creates the final stability report at the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal shows the content of /home/ga/Documents/exports/stability_report.txt containing stability analysis details.

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenRocket GUI to perform the repair rather than just editing the XML file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with OpenRocket sliders, buttons, or dialogs.

integrity.description: The report content reflects the actual state of the modified rocket, not just a copy-paste of the task description.
integrity.visual_evidence: The report text includes specific stability margin values (e.g., '1.5 cal') seen in the GUI.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create a dummy report file without actually fixing the rocket design.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the rocket geometry changing in the OpenRocket 2D/3D view before the report is written.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The initial rocket file has fins with a height of 0.015m (1.5cm), which makes it unstable. To pass, the agent must increase the fin height (the verifier looks for a height >= 0.05m). The final report must be saved to /home/ga/Documents/exports/stability_report.txt. A stable rocket in OpenRocket typically has a stability margin of at least 1.0 to 2.0 calibers.
